ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var op = (vars.operation default "CREATE") as String var id = (vars.orderId default vars.orderPayload.orderId default "") as String --- op match { case "CREATE" -> "Order Confirmation - #" ++ id case "UPDATE" -> "Order Update - #" ++ id case "DELETE" -> "Order Cancellation - #" ++ id else -> "Order Notification - #" ++ id }
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.customerEmail default vars.orderPayload.customerEmail default payload.customerEmail default p('email.user')) as String

logger.doc:name: Log Email Success
logger.message: #["[PAPI] " ++ (vars.operation as String default "CREATE") ++ " email notification sent to: " ++ (vars.targetEmail as String default "N/A")]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Failure
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Email send failed for operation " ++ (vars.operation as String default "") ++ " on order: " ++ (vars.orderId as String default "") ++ ". Continuing message flow."]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var sapiError = vars.sapiErrorPayload default null --- if (sapiError is Object) ( sapiError.errorMessage default sapiError.description default error.description default "Order processing failed" ) as String else ( sapiError as String default error.description default "Order processing failed" ) as String

set-variable.value: #['Order Processing Failed - Correlation ID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default correlationId default 'N/A')]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Failure Email Subject

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain
var customerName = ( vars.orderPayload.customerName default payload.customerName default "Customer" ) as String
var orderIdValue = ( if (!isEmpty((vars.orderId default "") as String)) vars.orderId else if (vars.sapiErrorPayload is Object) vars.sapiErrorPayload.orderId default "N/A" else "N/A" ) as String
var failureReasonValue = (vars.failureReason default "Order processing failed") as String
var correlationIdValue = ( vars.correlationId default correlationId default "N/A" ) as String
--- "Hello " ++ customerName ++ ",

" ++ "We could not process your order.

" ++ "Order ID: " ++ orderIdValue ++ "
" ++ "Failure Reason: " ++ failureReasonValue ++ "
" ++ "Correlation ID: " ++ correlationIdValue ++ "

" ++ "Please provide this Correlation ID if you contact support.

" ++ "Best regards,
" ++ "Order Management Team"

logger.doc:name: Log Failure Email Error
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Failure email could not be sent" ++ " | Recipient: " ++ (vars.failureTargetEmail default "N/A") ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ (vars.correlationId default correlationId default "N/A") ++ " | Reason: " ++ (error.description default "Unknown email error")]

logger.doc:name: Skip Failure Email
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Failure email skipped because customer email is unavailable" ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ (vars.correlationId default correlationId default "N/A")]
